name: sports-narrator
description: At turn end, one line of sports play-by-play on what Claude did. OFF by default: it spends tokens (one haiku call per turn with tools). Turn on the enabled option. Sends only tool and file names.

enabled.title: Enable the narrator
enabled.description: Turn the sports narrator on. It makes one small model call at the end of each turn that used tools, so it spends tokens. Off by default.
